V.0.2.8 UPDATE Notes:
⦁ Swimming mechanics added

Important Note: The ''Neverland'' Map has been removed from the game. Therefore, you need to delete the old save file. Optimization issues on the map were affecting gameplay. With the addition of our new atmospheric Two Maps, you will have more enjoyable times.

Sharing the problems you encounter in the game and your ideas within the concept are very important to us. Thank you for your feedback.

notes.title: Some important features that will be added to the V Gate world:
notes.notes:
[b]About V Gate, Some important developments:[/b]
In line with the feedback from V Gate players, new updates will come that will increase the atmosphere and playability by bringing some special innovations in the process!


[b]Some important features that will be added to the V Gate world:[/b]
• The main map will change and become more optimized.
• Climbing mechanics will be added
• Swimming mechanics will be added
• New Maps compatible with the story will be added
• An Arena system map connected to the central system will be added.
• V Gate Radio, which provides important information about the game, can be listened to by using items in the game.
• The main map will experience dynamic changes in line with the story and make you feel the atmosphere.
• Passenger vehicles will be added to accompany you in the story, starting with the Horse.
• Similar to the Role Play concept, temporal economic changes, new special narrative characters, and some surprise events that can make the world feel alive will be adapted into the game.
• NPC Characters will act more intelligently.
• More advanced; Farming, Electrical systems, and Base building mechanics will be added.
• Official Servers will be opened.

Don't forget to follow these innovations and new mechanics with the announcements we make on our social platforms and Steam when they are ready!
